income_statement.name: Revenue
income_statement.description: Revenue recognized during the reported period.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Shows the scale and growth of the core business.
income_statement.directionality: Higher is generally better when growth is profitable.

income_statement.name: Gross Profit
income_statement.why_it_matters: Funds operating expenses, investment, and profit.
income_statement.directionality: Higher and expanding is generally better.

income_statement.name: Operating Income
income_statement.description: Profit from core operations before interest and taxes.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Measures operating execution and cost discipline.

income_statement.name: Net Income
income_statement.description: Profit attributable after all recognized expenses.
income_statement.directionality: Higher and durable is generally better.
income_statement.formula: Revenue − all expenses, interest, and tax

income_statement.name: Diluted EPS
income_statement.description: Earnings allocated to each diluted weighted-average share.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Connects company profit to shareholder economics.
income_statement.directionality: Higher sustainable EPS is generally better.

income_statement.name: Operating Cash Flow
income_statement.why_it_matters: Tests whether accounting earnings convert into cash.
income_statement.directionality: Higher and consistent is generally better.
income_statement.formula: Cash inflows from operations − operating cash outflows

income_statement.name: Capital Expenditures
income_statement.description: Cash or obligations used for long-lived productive assets.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Indicates reinvestment needs and pressure on free cash flow.
income_statement.directionality: Context dependent; efficiency matters more than simply lower or higher.

income_statement.name: Cash
income_statement.description: Cash and cash equivalents at period end.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Supports liquidity, resilience, and strategic flexibility.
income_statement.directionality: More liquidity helps, but excess idle cash can reduce returns.

income_statement.name: Total Assets
income_statement.why_it_matters: Provides balance-sheet scale and capital-intensity context.

income_statement.name: Total Liabilities
income_statement.why_it_matters: Frames leverage, fixed claims, and financial risk.
income_statement.directionality: Lower relative to assets and cash flow is usually safer.

income_statement.name: Total Equity
income_statement.why_it_matters: Shows accumulated capital and losses, though buybacks can reduce it.
income_statement.directionality: Positive and improving is usually healthier; interpret with capital returns.

income_statement.name: Long-term Debt
income_statement.description: Debt due beyond the current period.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Creates fixed claims on future cash flows.
income_statement.directionality: Lower leverage is generally safer, subject to capital structure.
income_statement.formula: Reported current and non-current long-term borrowings

income_statement.name: Diluted Shares
income_statement.why_it_matters: Determines per-share ownership and earnings dilution.
income_statement.directionality: Lower is generally better when caused by value-accretive repurchases.

key_ratios.name: Gross Margin
key_ratios.description: Share of revenue remaining after direct costs.
key_ratios.why_it_matters: Shows product economics and pricing/cost performance.
key_ratios.directionality: Higher and durable is generally better.

key_ratios.name: Operating Margin
key_ratios.description: Share of revenue retained as operating profit.
key_ratios.why_it_matters: Measures operating efficiency and pricing power.
key_ratios.directionality: Higher and durable is generally better.

key_ratios.name: Net Margin
key_ratios.description: Share of revenue retained as net income.
key_ratios.directionality: Higher and durable is generally better.

key_ratios.name: Revenue Growth
key_ratios.why_it_matters: Provides context for operating performance, financial position, or valuation.
key_ratios.directionality: Interpret with the company's trend, peers, and business model.
key_ratios.formula: See the cited source and calculation context.

key_ratios.name: Operating Income Growth
key_ratios.why_it_matters: Provides context for operating performance, financial position, or valuation.
key_ratios.directionality: Interpret with the company's trend, peers, and business model.
key_ratios.formula: See the cited source and calculation context.

key_ratios.name: Net Income Growth
key_ratios.why_it_matters: Provides context for operating performance, financial position, or valuation.
key_ratios.directionality: Interpret with the company's trend, peers, and business model.
key_ratios.formula: See the cited source and calculation context.

valuation.name: P/E (TTM)
valuation.description: Price paid for each dollar of trailing earnings.
valuation.why_it_matters: Frames valuation relative to realized earnings.
valuation.directionality: Lower can be more attractive, but quality and growth matter.

valuation.name: P/S (annualized)
valuation.description: Market capitalization relative to annualized quarterly revenue.
valuation.why_it_matters: Useful when earnings are immature or volatile, but does not capture margins.
valuation.directionality: Lower is generally better, all else equal.

valuation.name: FCF Yield (annualized)
valuation.description: Annualized free cash flow relative to market value.
valuation.why_it_matters: Estimates cash generation available per dollar invested.
valuation.directionality: Higher is generally better when cash flow is sustainable.
valuation.formula: Annualized free cash flow ÷ market capitalization

valuation.name: EV/EBITDA
valuation.why_it_matters: Compares operating valuation across different capital structures.
valuation.directionality: Lower is generally better, subject to growth and quality.
